messages:
Maya (AE): Heads-up: Verdant POC finished. We did 200 qps steady plus two 4-min spikes to 600 qps. Customer flagged p99 spikes during spike ramps and asked for cost delta for 3x burst headroom. Need a short ops + pricing note for their procurement review tomorrow.

Jules (Eng): Can someone post the load profile + traces? Want to check batch sizes and shard moves.

upload-bot: Artifacts: s3://redwood-poc/verdant/1833333333/ (heatmap.png, traces.log, load.json)

Maya (AE): Load profile: {"phases": [{"duration_s": 1200, "qps": 200}, {"duration_s": 240, "qps": 600}, {"duration_s": 360, "qps": 200}], "avg_tokens": 300}

Ravi (SRE): Infra note: ran on dedicated a10g-small x3 across 2 AZs. Autoscaler hit and a single AZ experienced a 10-15s pod readiness delay during ramp which lines up with p99 jump. Recommend buffer_replicas=1 and prewarm_hook=90s. Also enable kv prefix cache warmup for top-50 prefixes.

Jules (Eng): Agreed. Also observed that batching window expanded at ramp start, increasing latency for short-turn requests. Mitigate by limiting max_batch_size during expected bursts. For Hosted customers we can route a small % to a lighter model variant during bursts if quality allows.

Tess (Security): Customer asked about BYOK KMS latency. Measured extra latency = ~6-14ms per request depending on KMS region. We can offer short envelope key caching (30s) but will document risks and rotation cadence. I'll start the vendor questionnaire.

Maya (AE): Pricing: they want a single conservative number for procurement comparing on-demand vs committed. Can we get a worst-case on-demand percent and a committed percent?

Jules (Eng): Quick ballpark: on-demand worst-case ~+30% monthly for 3x burst headroom (mostly transient compute), committed 12mo reserved ~+8-10% with buffer replicas. I'll produce a small table with A10G vs A100 assumptions.

Ravi (SRE): Runbook items I'll add: set min_replicas=2 per AZ, buffer_replicas=1, prewarm script (example):
```bash
for i in $(seq 1 150); do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d @sample.json &
done
```

Tess (Security): I'll include KMS latency ranges and audit log export options in the doc. If they require HSM attestation we need Legal loop.

Maya (AE): Action items: Jules to send one-pager + cost numbers, Ravi to PR runbook, Tess to draft KMS answers. Need assembled one-pager by 9am PT tomorrow.

Jules (Eng): On it 609. Will post draft by tomorrow AM.

Maya (AE): Thanks team :thumbsup:
